title: Greenlane Prioritization & Model-Swap Playbook — Quarterly Roadmap
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a practical, ops-first playbook that governs quarterly prioritization of 'green lanes' (preferred hosted API model variants), stepwise model swaps, and rollback/fallback procedures for the model catalog. The playbook will map OKRs to initiative lanes, define acceptance criteria for canaries, and provide an operator checklist for automated and manual swaps to avoid regressions during peak traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Greenlane taxonomy: at least three priority lanes (Green / Amber / Surge) defined with explicit capacity and cost thresholds
Model swap flow documented end-to-end: canary slice selection, traffic ramp policy, metrics gates, and automated rollback triggers
Runbook contains operator checklist and CLI commands for emergency manual rollback; tested in staging (load test pass >95% of SLOs)
OKR mapping sheet links initiatives to measurable signals (latency, p50/p95, unit cost delta, quality regression delta)
Telemetry dashboard template and alert rules checked into Console: model-health, quality-regressions, cost-drift
